steps.action: Place one tile along the top of each long side wall, centered between the two end studs.
watch_for: Leave the single end studs exposed at both ends of each wall
Put one tile on the front wall and one on the back wall, not both on one side

steps.action: Press one plate along the top of each long side wall, covering the tiles and the end studs.
watch_for: Align each plate flush over the full wall length so it locks onto both end studs
